finalResult.nextParagraphText: “If we go only by the power available to us in the galaxy, the chance is zero percent, rounded down, but if members from outside the universe get involved?” Caleb said with a slightly more serious tone. “While the success rate is still considered way too low, it isn’t zero. I wouldn’t really think about it too much, though. I have a hard time seeing them ever accepting a commission to take you out as things are now. If they were willing to do that, then what would have been the purpose of making me a Judge?”
